title: Shared definitions (schema version 1)
description: Definitions that the other schema files reference. This file validates nothing by itself.

schemaVersion.description: The schema version of the file. A client rejects any value it does not support.

id.description: A stable identifier for a series, item, bundle or baseline. Lowercase letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores, and it starts with a letter or digit. It appears in file paths and URLs, so it never holds a slash.

releaseId.description: The identifier of one release. It is a path segment under /v1/releases/, so it is lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only.

areaId.description: A Colaide-assigned area identifier. It is never reused, never changes and is never removed from a later release.

keyId.description: A signing key ID. It is neutral: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, and it never names the app.

text.description: A non-empty single-line label or name.

timestamp.description: A UTC instant, written exactly as YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ with no fraction and no offset, so the same instant always has the same bytes.

date.description: A calendar date, written as YYYY-MM-DD.

sha256.description: A SHA-256 digest as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

base64.description: Standard base64 (RFC 4648 section 4) with padding and no line breaks.

measureType.description: What a value measures. A client never combines, plots on one scale or converts between measure types.

geographyLevel.description: The level of an area. The fallback order is municipality, prefecture, region, national. A municipality covers every city, ward, town, village and survey area.

frequency.description: How often the source publishes a new observation period.

taxTreatment.description: Whether a yen price includes consumption tax. Only a retail price series is restricted to the first three values. Use not_applicable for an index or an expenditure series.

observationStatus.description: observed: first published value. revised: the source later changed the value. missing: the source has no value for the period. suppressed: the source withheld the value.

physicalQuantityUnit.description: A unit for the quantity a price covers. Mass (g, kg) and volume (mL, L) convert losslessly within their own family. A count (piece) never converts to a mass or volume.

quantityUnit.description: A physical unit, or household for a per-household expenditure.

periodWeekly.description: A weekly period as an ISO 8601 week: YYYY-Www.

anyPeriod.description: An observation period in any frequency. The series schema pins the form to the series frequency.

value.description: An observed value. Never negative. Never a stand-in for a missing value.

source.description: Where a series or baseline came from, with the credit the source requires.

creditText.description: The source line in the form the publisher requires, for example 出典：「調査名」（府省名）.

processedCreditText.description: The statement shown with any value that Colaide derives, for example 「調査名」（府省名）を加工して作成.
